title: labs findings frontmatter
description: Schema v1 for YAML frontmatter in 03_findings/sample_XX.md files.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be 1 for files conforming to this schema.

sha256.description: Full SHA-256 hex digest of the primary sample file.

analyst.description: Handle or name of the analyst who performed the analysis.

date_acquired.description: ISO-8601 date the sample was acquired (YYYY-MM-DD).

date_analyzed.description: ISO-8601 date analysis was completed or last updated (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: Lifecycle status of this sample slot.

family_guess.description: Working hypothesis for malware family or classification.

items.description: Lowercase hyphenated tag, e.g. nsis, fake-alert.

tags.description: Analytical tags for cross-referencing. All lowercase, hyphen-separated.

items.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID, e.g. T1036 or T1547.001.

mitre_techniques.description: ATT&CK technique IDs observed or inferred from this sample.

mb_url.description: MalwareBazaar (or other source) URL for the sample.

procmon_run.description: Whether a Procmon capture was taken during dynamic analysis.

dynamic_complete.description: Whether dynamic analysis is considered complete for this sample.

_breaking_changes.1: Initial schema. All fields listed above are required at version 1.
